title: Cavity architecture based modulation of ligand binding tunnels in plant START domains.
authors: Mahtha, Sanjeet Kumar; Kumari, Kamlesh; Gaur, Vineet; Yadav, Gitanjali
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习建模植物START结构域并分析其配体结合腔，虽涉及蛋白结构预测，但核心是脂质转运而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅提及HD-Zip家族腔体消失与DNA结合功能相关，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模与机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The Steroidogenic acute regulatory protein (StAR)-related lipid transfer (START) domain represents an evolutionarily conserved superfamily of lipid transfer proteins widely distributed across the tree of life. Despite significant expansion in plants, knowledge about this domain remains inadequate in plants. In this work, we explore the role of cavity architectural modulations in START protein evolution and functional diversity. We use deep-learning approaches to generate plant START domain models, followed by surface accessibility studies and a comprehensive structural investigation of the rice START family. We validate 28 rice START domain models, delineate binding cavities, measure pocket volumes, and compare these with mammalian counterparts to understand evolution of binding preferences. Overall, plant START domains retain the ancestral alpha/beta helix-grip signature, but we find subtle variation in cavity architectures, resulting in significantly smaller ligand-binding tunnels in the plant kingdom. We identify cavity lining residues (CLRs) responsible for reduction in ancestral tunnel space, and these appear to be class specific, and unique to plants, providing a mechanism for the observed shift in domain function. For instance, mammalian cavity lining residues A135, G181 and A192 have evolved to larger CLRs across the plant kingdom, contributing to smaller sizes, minimal STARTs being the largest, while members of type-IV HD-Zip family show almost complete obliteration of lipid binding cavities, consistent with their present-day DNA binding functions. In summary, this work quantifies plant START structural & functional divergence, bridging current knowledge gaps.
abstract_zh: 类固醇生成急性调节蛋白（StAR）相关脂质转移（START）结构域代表了一个进化上保守的脂质转移蛋白超家族，广泛分布于生命树中。尽管在植物中显著扩展，但对该结构域在植物中的了解仍不充分。在本研究中，我们探讨了腔体结构修饰在START蛋白进化及功能多样性中的作用。我们利用深度学习方法生成植物START结构域模型，随后进行表面可及性研究，并对水稻START家族进行全面的结构调查。我们验证了28个水稻START结构域模型，描绘了结合腔体，测量了口袋体积，并与哺乳动物对应物进行比较，以理解结合偏好的进化。总体而言，植物START结构域保留了祖先的α/β螺旋-夹持特征，但我们发现腔体结构存在细微变异，导致植物界中配体结合隧道显著缩小。我们识别出腔体衬里残基（CLRs）是导致祖先隧道空间减少的原因，这些残基似乎具有类别特异性且为植物所独有，为观察到的结构域功能转变提供了机制。例如，哺乳动物腔体衬里残基A135、G181和A192在植物界中已进化为更大的CLRs，导致尺寸减小，其中最小STARTs最大，而类型-IV HD-Zip家族成员则几乎完全消除脂质结合腔体，与其当前的DNA结合功能一致。总之，本研究量化了植物START结构与功能的差异，弥合了当前知识空白。
